band: band11 -- r=4 Reeve-dimension census, hunter 11/12: UNBOUNDED WEIGHT, TARGETED (maximise V/c over all shapes)
target: counterexample to the King-Tollu-Toumazet (2004) positivity conjecture: a triple (lam,mu,nu), |lam|+|mu|=|nu|, whose stretched LR polynomial P(n)=c(n nu; n lam, n mu) has a strictly negative coefficient
cell: r = 4  (hive polytope Q lives in R^3 = the Reeve dimension; deg P = dim Q <= 3)

moduli_reduction.claim: Q(lam,mu,nu) for r=4 depends on (lam,mu,nu) only through the 9 gaps a=(l1-l2,l2-l3,l3-l4), b=(m1-m2,m2-m3,m3-m4), c=(n1-n2,n2-n3,n3-n4), up to an INTEGER translation of R^3; hence L(n)=#(nQ cap Z^3), V, h*, P are functions of the gap vector alone. A gap vector is realisable by partitions iff D = Cw-Aw-Bw == 0 (mod 4), Aw=3a3+2a2+a1 etc.
moduli_reduction.consequence: scanning gap vectors is a census at UNBOUNDED WEIGHT: one gap vector = infinitely many triples (lam,mu,nu) of arbitrarily large |nu|, all with the same P
moduli_reduction.verified_this_run: band11_xcheck.py: 250 random gap vectors, each lifted to two different partition triples; hive4.py gives identical L(1..3), V, h*, P for both lifts (250/250), and identical values to band11_vcscan.exe (250/250, 0 failures)

exact_identities_used.a1: 6 a1 = 11 + 2 h1 - h2 + 2 h3 = 3*c + 3*h3 - V   (h3 = # interior lattice points)
exact_identities_used.negativity_criterion: a1 < 0  <==>  V > 3*(c + h3).  Hence V/c > 3 is NECESSARY, and when c = 4 (h*_1 = 0, an empty lattice 3-polytope such as a Reeve simplex T(p,q)) it is exactly V >= 13
exact_identities_used.scaling: for integer t, Q(t*g) = t*Q(g), so a1(t*g) = t*a1(g): the SIGN of a1 is constant along each integer ray in gap space, and V/c -> 6, V/(c+h3) -> 3 from below along every ray. A large V/c record is therefore a scale artifact; the scale-free discriminants are the sign of a1, the ratio V/(c+h3) (must exceed 3) and max V at c = 4 (must reach 13)
